A few moments from today's Satisfactory let's play

Full thing can be consumed digitally here: www.youtube.com/watch?v=IbzT...

#video #gaming #satisfactory #youtube
It's a pretty good self contained commentary on the party as a whole right now tbh

I changed my party registration from Democrat to unaffiliated quite a few years ago now, and just got a spam text begging me to change my affiliation back to Dem

Genuinely embarassing. It didn’t mention any policy whatsoever, just begged to change my affiliation.

“That tax alone is bringing in half a billion a year”

Like bruh

Literally just tax the rich like

That’s kinda it
Apple investing one of their several trillions of dollars into developing the worlds least reliable HDMI port for their pro-grade laptops

Kenya says it couldn’t get behind the Microsoft data center because it would literally require a third of the country’s power supply.

“To switch on that one data centre, we would need to shut off power for half the country,” said the president.

Just posted the next installment of my #Satisfactory series!

Today, we unlock the long awaited Jetpack, only to immediately be let down far more than we're lifted up.

Watch on FUNDEAVORANCE: www.youtube.com/watch?v=IbzT...

Re: volunteers at food banks:

"One of those volunteers was Enoch Asmah, who had come to Arizona from Ghana last June to be with his wife, who is a student. He said he hadn’t expected to see this level of need in the U.S."
I've been gathering some research on the impacts of the truly unbelievable amount of domestic policy changes under this rotting cabbage of an administration, but this is a good article.
“I have a hard stop at 3” when the meeting is about if we are gonna spend taxes on sending thousands of tons of munitions overseas vs feeding our children
Me matey in Christ, they stopped at a closed door.

Of all the unhinged, detached-from-reality takes I've seen from conservative online spaces, the one that takes the cake is a recent comment I read which claimed "the Democrats will stop at NOTHING to get their way"

And I

Uh

Hm? 😐

What's up with being a meanie?

Idgi

In fact, there will be no more pearl clutching of any kind

Fully outlawed

Illegal

straight_to_jail dot webm

Reminder: whoever is the next non-Republican president must routinely talk about running for more than two terms, and any Republican official who makes the slightest upset noise about that shall be dutifully launched into the sun

When they go low, we make them bite the curb

Maybe try that in the next DNC speech
